publications.title: A Siamese network-based Xception for Face Recognition
publications.venue: Ali Habibi, Mahlagha Afrasiabi, and Moniba Chaparian | Journal of Electrical and Computer Engineering Innovations (JECEI), 14(1), 33-40, 2026
publications.description: A transfer learning approach for one-shot face verification using a Siamese network with an Xception backbone, Euclidean distance, and contrastive loss. The model achieved 97.6% verification accuracy on LFW and 96.25% on ORL, demonstrating robust performance in small-sample settings.
